HPX_PRINTERS_DETAILS.py.summary: This class models the HPX Printer Details screen. It provides methods for interacting with various tiles and buttons, including camera scan, print photos, shortcuts, and product information. The class implements robust retry and verification patterns for UI interactions, ensuring reliable automation flows. All methods follow consistent input/output parameter structures and functional purposes.
